notes.title: Version 1.2.1
notes.content:
Ver. 1.2.1
Celebrate 1 year of DOTO with a month of rewards and boosted Moon-Soom buffs.

Starting April 1st and going throughout the month Illune will offer a calendar of rewards. Rewards include buffs, energy/astrolabes, upgrade materials and a powerful new offhand focus "Ephemeral Orb".
From 3/28-5/1 the daily Moon-Soom effect is doubled.
Use the new code "ONEYEAR" for a collecting of extra loot.
New offhand focus: "Ephemeral Orb" this event exclusive item will be added to the loot pool during the event month from 4/1-5/1 and grants a new effect "Increased damage from single target attacks."

New consumable: "Useless Bauble" grants a tiny 1% boost to all Non-Combat Traits for 31 days and is an incredibly rare drop from high difficulty Dungeons and Breaches.

Fixes & Polish
Improved the way loot can be generated to improve load times.
Made improvements to the Shop and Jeweler to prevent crashes.
Made improvements to how the wardrobe saves and stores information.
Added features to Paragon to give rewards for certain tiers.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0

Updated auto-mode to help encourage "All" attack type to be used in crowds.

notes.title: Version 1.1.9
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.9
New Challenge: Mo Problems
Face a new Challenge against Mo, the bloodsucking creature from the Breach. Craft the new Champion equipment "Crimson Boots" that grant a 10-20% chance to trigger Life Steal effects twice.

Salvage and Rerun
Players can now Salvage and Rerun any Dungeon or Breach after beating a Breach on Superior. This will salvage all unlocked equipment with a rarity of rare or lower allowing players to grind more dungeons without returning to Topia.

notes.title: Version 1.1.8
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.8
Event: Solstice
Celebrate the Solstice event with various new additions and rewards.
All month enjoy 2x bonuses on the daily Moon-Soom, talk to Illune to collect from the daily calendar and make use of 2 powerful new Artifacts.

All Moon-Soom effects are doubled.
Illune provides a special reward calendar to collect from.
Use the code "SOLSTICE2024" for a package of items.

2 new Artifacts have been added to the shop
Unconquered Light--Provides up to 25 Dexterity per player level, 50% boost to Critical Chance and up to 12% Critical Chance.
Yule Goat--Provides up to 25 Dexterity per player level, 50% boost to Critical Damage and up to 200% Critical Damage.

Mask of Taku-Ra has become empowered from the Solstice and will now provide a 25% boost to Critical Chance and Critical Damage along with it's current effects.

notes.title: Jables Challenge's
notes.content:
Version 1.1 (Jables Challenge’s)

Challenges
A new gamemode titled Challenges has been added, this allows players to fight waves of enemies that can scale endlessly. See how far you can rise on the leaderboard and contend against other players for the top rank while hunting down new and powerful equipment.
Challenges start with “Oops, all Glubs!” and is focused on the enemy “Glub”, more Challenge types will be added at a later date.
Challenges also introduce a new set for players to collect in the form of 3 swords that drop exclusively from Challenges, with a focus on damage these blades can greatly strengthen the player.
Challenges also introduce a new rarity known as “Champion”, this rarity has to be crafted using Teori’s expertise once a recipe has been unlocked. The item making its debut is “Gloop Fist” a offhand weapon with a powerful auto attack at the cost of mana.

Challenges are available through the Jester once the player beats a Breach for the first time.

Balance
With the introduction of Challenges a balance pass has been applied to existing companions, the following companions now have legendary bonuses to help make them even more powerful and unique compared to rare companions. (This effect will apply to any existing and future version of these companions.)
Mr. Doughnut: +15% boost to Revitalize.
Thirsty: +20% boost to Dexterity.
Trinity: +20% boost to Constitution.
Glimmer: +5% boost to all Major Traits.

Shop
A major update has been applied to the shop that includes new items such as armor and materials.
The Tailor has over 5 new armor sets on daily rotations, and the Curios has added a new section to purchase materials used in upgrading Artifacts and Companions.
The Jeweler is undergoing a rework on UI and has a new page similar to the shop, this page offers the usual Astrolabes but also has Astro-Packs available and will expand with new offers at a later date.
The Snek Salesman has gone through a few changes as well and will offer occasional deals to players upon login.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.3
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.3
Major backend changes to prevent issues with loot disappearing/multiplying/duplicating. 
Note: This update shifts the way loot is saved, prior to the change all loot was saved on Playfab inventory servers. With the update loot saves to a more stable player save file, players with inventory loot items will have items converted once they login to the save file. This process happens automatically in the background and should not effect gameplay.
